milestone: R7 Control-plane Authority and Completion Gates

strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Makes unattended phase and milestone completion decisions depend on Product Charter capability evidence rather than CI or PR status alone.
Keeps completion authority in repository control-plane guard evidence without moving policy into the VSIX or bypassing runtime safety boundaries.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development, with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement at the controller boundary.
answers.new_capability: CI can reject phase or milestone completion evidence that lacks Product Charter mapping, concrete capability transition, behavior evidence, safety/debt classification, or anti-wrapper proof.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: Diagnostics, phase-value, and control-plane authority guards prevent wrapper drift and stale source-of-truth files, but none validates completion claims themselves.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Brownie could still close phases or milestones on PR merge, CI success, endpoint count, string presence, or manifest existence without proving product progress.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M49.3 changed runtime Mode Pack route execution and R7.1 changed source-of-truth authority; R7.2 adds completion-evidence enforcement.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase adds no JSON-RPC method.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. The phase adds no runtime or VSIX summary/report surface; it adds an executable guard.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Product runtime behavior does not change. Development-control behavior changes because weak completion claims now fail the guard path.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A scheduled caller can trust completion state only after deterministic evidence categories pass, reducing autonomous drift into wrapper-only closeouts.
answers.milestone_progress: R7 gains the completion-proof half of its authority and completion gate objective after R7.1 source-of-truth unification.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: R7.2 adds the product completion guard and wires it into package/VSIX checks. Review must confirm the guard cannot silently weaken phase-value, diagnostics, or source-of-truth enforcement.

exit_criteria: product completion guard validates the current R7.2 completion evidence block
fixture tests reject CI-only, PR-only, manifest-only, endpoint-count, and source-token completion evidence
fixture tests reject missing Product Charter capability mapping
fixture tests reject missing concrete transition or behavior evidence
fixture tests reject wrapper/report-only completion without bounded blocker-removal classification
fixture tests reject missing technical debt classification
CI runs the product completion guard through the existing VSIX check path
phase-value guard detects future product completion guard changes as guard-engine changes
no new RPC, runtime route, diagnostics wrapper, readiness, history, digest, verdict, inspection, preview, or VSIX-owned policy is added
behavior_evidence: scripts/guard-product-completion.test.mjs covers accepted completion evidence and negative CI-only, missing mapping, missing behavior, wrapper-only, blocker-removal, and missing technical-debt cases
scripts/guard-product-completion.mjs validates the real current phase-value manifest
pnpm --filter brownie-vsix check runs diagnostics, control-plane authority, product-completion, and phase-value guards before TypeScript typecheck

accepted_capability: Executable Product Completion Gate for phase and milestone completion evidence
behavior_evidence: Node fixture tests reject weak completion evidence and accept bounded Product Charter-aligned evidence
Repository guard validates the current R7.2 manifest before CI can pass
safety_boundary: does not read external automation state
does not expose raw prompts, provider responses, file content, stdout, stderr, command text, environment values, absolute paths, canonical paths, or secrets
does not mutate repository, workspace, Git, runtime, ledger, provider, or external automation state
non_goals: no completion report, readiness, history, digest, verdict, inspection, preview, or summary surface
rejected_alternatives: Product Completion Gate bundled into R7.1
technical_debt: R7.2 gates completion evidence but does not itself implement future product runtime milestones after R7
External automation state still records long historical fields; R7.2 intentionally validates repository completion evidence rather than migrating external state
next_capability_rationale: After R7.2 merges, an independent phase-complete assessment should decide whether R7 can move to milestone closeout
If R7 closes, the next milestone should return to Product Charter runtime capability progression rather than another control-plane wrapper
